::: {.home-profile-copy}
::: {.home-profile-name}
Dr. Shenglai Yin.
:::

I study infectious-disease dynamics at the intersection of disease ecology, animal movement, and global change. My research combines quantitative analysis—including statistical modeling, network analysis, and machine learning—with mechanistic approaches, especially agent-based models, to understand how pathogens transmit and emerge across scales.
